intro: Hi! I'm the Blitz Wallet bot. ⚡ I use your Blitz Wallet Connect account, not your main wallet. Check your balance, ask for money, and pay people right here in Telegram. Stay safe: never share your PIN or secret backup words with anyone.
help: What can I do? Money /balance – See how much money you have /transactions – See your recent payments /receive – Ask someone to pay you /send – Pay someone Your Blitz app /status – See your payments and requests /connect – Connect your Blitz app /reconnect – Connect your Blitz app again /disconnect – Disconnect your Blitz app /language – Change language Good to know • Money is counted in sats. A sat is a tiny piece of bitcoin. • To ask for money in any chat, type @BlitzWalletBot and an amount, like 5000 pizza.

paths.manage: Blitz → Profile → Accounts → Wallet Connect → Manage Connections

common.slow_down: Too fast! Wait a moment, then try again.
common.connect_first: First, connect your Blitz app. Tap /start.
common.wallet_gone: Your Blitz app is not connected anymore.
common.busy: I'm busy right now. Try again in a bit.
common.inflight_block_connect: A payment is still going through. Wait a bit, then try again.
common.generic_error: Oops, something went wrong. Please try again.
common.unknown_command: Sorry, I don't know that one. Tap /help to see what I can do.
common.group_secret_warning: ⚠️ Someone shared a secret code here. I deleted it, but other people may have seen it. To be safe, delete that connection in $t(paths.both).

wallet.trouble_busy: I'm busy right now. Try again in a bit.
wallet.trouble_timeout: Blitz didn't answer. Open the Blitz app on your phone, then try again.
wallet.trouble_refused: Blitz won't let me do that. Connect again with /reconnect.
wallet.trouble_default: Something went wrong with Blitz. Try again later.

connect.no_methods: That connection doesn't let me do anything. Make a new one and turn some things on.
connect.connected_intro: Here's what I can do for you:
connect.some_off: A few things are switched off. You can turn them on anytime by using the /reconnect command.
connect.sending_off: I can't pay yet because I need a bit more permission. To turn on paying, type /reconnect and make sure to add the payment permission in Blitz.
connect.replaced: Your old connection was replaced. Delete it in $t(paths.both) so it can't be used.
connect.choose_pin: One last step: pick a 6-digit PIN. It's like a lock for your payments. You'll type it each time you pay.
connect.already_connected: You're already connected. To start over, use /reconnect.
connect.pasted_secret: I can't connect with a pasted code, so I deleted it. Anyone who saw it could use it, so delete that connection in $t(paths.both). Then tap /start and use the Connect account button.

pairing.title: Connect to Blitz Wallet
pairing.body: Tap the button below on a phone that has Blitz, then approve the connection. You can change what I'm allowed to do, and remove my access, anytime in Blitz.
pairing.approved_but_inflight: You said yes in Blitz, but a payment is still going through. Try /start again later.
pairing.relay_unsupported: That connection won't work with me, so I didn't connect. Delete it in $t(paths.both).
pairing.expired: That link has expired. Tap /start to get a new one.
pairing.check_hint: Approved it in Blitz but nothing happened here? Tap “I approved it”.
pairing.not_yet: Not yet. Say yes in Blitz first, then tap “I approved it” again.

pin.expired: This keypad is too old. Please start again.
pin.cancel_setup: Stopped. Paying stays off. To try again, use /reconnect.
pin.weak: That PIN is too easy to guess. Pick a different 6-digit PIN.
pin.repeat_prompt: Type your PIN again to confirm it.
pin.mismatch: Those didn't match. Pick a 6-digit PIN to start over.
pin.set_done: 🔐 PIN saved. To pay someone, paste their payment request here.
pin.pay_prompt: Type your PIN to pay {{amount}} sats.
pin.locked_try_later: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{duration}}.
pin.locked_nothing_sent: Locked after too many wrong PINs. No money was sent.
pin.too_many_locked:
Too many wrong PINs. Locked for {{duration}}. No money was sent.
Forgot your PIN? Use /reconnect to make a new one.
pin.wrong_remaining_one: Wrong PIN. You have 1 try left.
pin.wrong_remaining_other: Wrong PIN. You have {{count}} tries left.
pin.disabled:
Too many wrong PINs. Paying is now off. No money was sent.
If that wasn't you, delete the Telegram connection in Blitz right now. To pay again, use /reconnect.

send.paste_prompt: Paste the payment request you want to pay. It's a long code that often starts with “ln”.
send.not_enabled: Paying is off for this connection. Use /reconnect and turn on paying.
send.err_network: That payment request isn't for real bitcoin, so I can't pay it.
send.err_no_amount: That payment request has no amount. Ask for a new one that does.
send.err_expired: That payment request has expired. Ask for a new one.
send.err_invalid: That doesn't look like a payment request.
send.over_limit: That's too much for one payment. The most I can send at once is {{max}} sats. Use the Blitz app for bigger payments.
send.already_in_progress: This payment is already going through. Don't pay it again.
send.confirm_warn: Only pay if you know who this is for and why.
send.confirm_expired: That took too long, so I stopped. No money was sent. Paste the payment request again to try.
send.expired_nothing_sent: That took too long. No money was sent.
send.another_in_progress: Another payment is still going through. Wait a bit.
send.another_in_progress_nothing_sent: Another payment is still going through. Wait a bit. No money was sent.
send.conn_unusable: This connection doesn't work anymore. No money was sent. Use /reconnect to connect again.
send.sending: ⚡ Paying {{amount}} sats… Please don't pay it again.
send.submit_unknown: ⚠️ I'm not sure yet if it went through. Don't pay it again. I'll tell you when I know.
send.unknown_first: ⏳ I'm not sure yet if {{amount}} sats went through. It might still work. Don't pay it again. I'll tell you more soon.
send.unknown_giveup: ⚠️ After 3 days, I still don't know if {{amount}} sats went through. Please check the Blitz app.
send.failed: ❌ Paying {{amount}} sats didn't work. {{why}} Check the Blitz app before you try again.
send.fail_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You hit the limit you set in Blitz.
send.fail_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: You don't have enough money in Blitz.
send.fail_RESTRICTED: This connection isn't allowed to pay.
send.fail_UNAUTHORIZED: This connection was deleted in Blitz.
send.fail_RATE_LIMITED: Blitz is busy. Try again soon.
send.fail_NOT_SENT: Blitz didn't get the payment in time.
send.no_pin: Paying is off because you haven't set a PIN. Use /reconnect to set one.

receive.not_enabled: Asking for money is off for this connection. Connect again with /reconnect.
receive.open_cap: You already have {{max}} open requests. Wait until they are paid or expire.
receive.unusable: Oops, something went wrong. Please try again.
receive.amount_mismatch: Oops, something went wrong. Please try again.
receive.usage: Type an amount in sats, like this: /receive 21000
receive.ask: How many sats do you want to ask for? You can add a note after the amount, like 21000 pizza.
receive.created: Asking for {{amount}} sats{{memo}}. This request expires in {{minutes}} min.
receive.copy_hint: Tap Copy, then send it to the person who will pay you.

invoice_check.not_tracking: I'm not watching that one anymore.

balance.not_enabled: Seeing your balance is off for this connection. Connect again with /reconnect.

transactions.not_enabled: Seeing your history is off for this connection. Connect again with /reconnect.
transactions.title: Your recent payments (page {{page}})

status.nothing: Nothing yet. You haven't paid or asked for money from here.

disconnect.inflight_warn: ⚠️ A payment is still going through. After you disconnect, I can't tell you how it ended. Check the Blitz app.
disconnect.prompt: Disconnect your Blitz app? I will forget everything about it.{{warn}}
disconnect.done:
Done. You're disconnected.

Also delete the Telegram connection in $t(paths.both) so it can't be used again.

reconnect.prompt: Connect again? I'll disconnect your Blitz app and send you a new link.

inline.description: Ask for money from your Blitz
inline.creating: {{name}} is sending a request for {{amount}} sats{{memo}}…
inline.amount_fail: I can't ask for that amount.
